newsitem.title: CHILE: Unemployment in Chile at 6.3 pct in March-to-May.
newsitem.headline: Unemployment in Chile at 6.3 pct in March-to-May.

text.p: Unemployment in Chile rose for the fourth month in a row to 6.3 percent in March-to-May, from 6.0 percent in February-to-April, the National Statistics Institute reported.
The jobless rate was unchanged, however, from the 6.3 percent rate in the March-to-May quarter of 1996, the institute reported.
The new figure clearly reflected Chile's economic slowdown in the first half of the year, although economists say growth is accelerating in the second half.
Unemployment stood at 5.4 percent in the December-to-February period and then rose to 5.8 percent in the first calendar quarter of the year.
Youth unemployment continued to far outstrip the overall rate, at 15.6 percent in the March-to-May period, up from 14.3 percent in the previous quarter, the institute said.

Metropolitan Santiago posted the highest unemployment at 7.5 percent, up from 6.8 percent in the previous quarter, followed by the southern Eighth Region at 7.1 percent, down from 7.3 percent, the institute said.
